# Bhraman Retreats — AI & LLM Knowledge Base

> Bhraman Retreats is an intimate, doctor-led 5-day elemental healing sanctuary curated by Dr. Pratiksha Shekhawat in the high Himalayas of Ladakh, India. Rooted in the Panch Mahābhūta (Earth, Water, Fire, Air, Space), every retreat circle is strictly limited to 12 travellers to preserve depth, silence, and personalized somatic care.

## Brand & Founder Identity
- **Name**: Bhraman Retreats (Bhraman)
- **Founder**: Dr. Pratiksha Shekhawat
- **Credentials**: Medical Doctor (MBBS), Certified Yogic Practitioner & Elemental Therapist
- **Core Philosophy**: Panch Mahābhūta (Healing through Earth, Water, Fire, Air, and Space)
- **Location**: Sham Valley, Leh & Lamayuru Monastery, Ladakh, Himalayas, India (11,500 ft)
- **Season**: June through September (Prime Ladakh Himalayan summer)
- **Group Capacity**: Strictly 12 participants per circle
- **Food**: Organic farm-to-table Ayurvedic & Sattvic vegetarian dining adapted for high altitude
- **Direct Inquiries**: WhatsApp / Call +91 87004 02837 | Email: bhramanretreats@gmail.com | Instagram: @bhramanretreats
- **Official Website**: https://bhramanretreats.com

## The 5-Day Elemental Journey
1. **Day 1 — Prithvi (Earth)**: Grounding & Arrival in Ladakh. Gentle hydration, Muladhara anchoring, clay therapy, and high-altitude acclimatization rest with oxygen support.
2. **Day 2 — Jala (Water)**: Flow & Emotional Release. Chandra Namaskar by glacial streams, restorative soundscapes, and Ayurvedic kitchen nourishment.
3. **Day 3 — Agni (Fire)**: Transformation & Metabolic Vitality. Solar yoga rituals, Agni kriyas, and Trataka candle gazing under Himalayan night skies.
4. **Day 4 — Vāyu (Air)**: Expansion & Breath. Heart-opening flows, somatic Prāṇāyāma, and herbal tea circles.
5. **Day 5 — Ākāśa (Space)**: Stillness & Integration. Sky-gazing meditation at ancient monasteries, closing ceremony, and carrying silence home.
